note: What `capture host setup` puts under out/host on a Linux machine so a Windows game can run there (capture/host/proton.py). Pinned as installed and measured on 2026-11-23; nothing here is committed or redistributed by us.

runtime.title: Steam Linux Runtime 4 (the container GE-Proton11 runs in; its tool id 4183110)
runtime.name: SteamLinuxRuntime_4.tar.xz

packages.title: Xvfb (the headless display), xkbcomp, xdotool and what they need: Ubuntu packages, unpacked into out/host/sysroot, not installed

ngx.title: NVIDIA NGX for Wine (nvngx.dll, _nvngx.dll): DLSS in a Proton prefix. From NVIDIA's driver package of the machine's own driver version, unpacked, not installed

conda.title: ffmpeg (packaging takes into videos), from conda-forge into the machine's conda environment (CAPTURE_ENV, config host.env, else ~/.conda/envs/game-capture); only installed when no ffmpeg is found
